question: An interview question that asks about one of your weaknesses would be answered best by
options: admitting the weakness
asking if it is necessary to talk about weaknesses
naming a weakness and turning it into a strength
saying that you do not have any weaknesses
correct: naming a weakness and turning it into a strength

question: At the end of a meeting, you should
options: Ask a lot of questions to test the team members' understanding of the discussion
Be brief and recapture the key points
Be the first to leave the meeting room
Take group photo and have conversation with members to build personal relationships with them
correct: Be brief and recapture the key points

question: "Circular argument" is a type of fallacy in which:
options: A weak argument set up to be easily refuted, distracting attention from stronger arguments.
The proposition is used to prove itself. Assumes the very thing it aims to prove.
Appeals to a common belief of some people, often prejudicial, and states everyone holds this belief. Also called the Bandwagon Fallacy, as people "jump on the bandwagon" of a perceived popular view.
We claim the truth of the very matter in question, as if it were already an obvious conclusion.
correct: The proposition is used to prove itself. Assumes the very thing it aims to prove.

question: Creative thinking is
options: a way of employing strategies to clear your mind so that your thoughts and ideas can transcend what appear to be the limitations of a problem
important because it helps you look at problems and situations from a fresh perspective
a way to develop novel or unorthodox solutions that do not depend wholly on past or current solutions
All of these are correct
correct: All of these are correct

question: Choose the best answer for this question "Why should we hire you?"
options: Nothing! I'm perfect!
I am a professional in this way.
I'd really love to bring my diverse skill set to your company.
I deserved.
correct: I'd really love to bring my diverse skill set to your company.

question: Choose the best answer for this question: "How do you handle stress and pressure?"
options: I don't know
I can't. I don't know how
It was my role to manage the invoicing process
I try to react to situations, rather than to stress
correct: I try to react to situations, rather than to stress

question: David has just been given the task of delivering an oral presentation to the marketing department of the organization he joined two months ago. The first thing David should do is ...
options: analyze the audience
determine the purpose of the presentation
draft an outline
gather supporting data
correct: determine the purpose of the presentation

question: Deborah Duarte and Nancy Snyder point out that "technology cannot make up for poor planning or ill-conceived meetings. In fact, it can make the situation worse." In order to avoid such problems in a virtual meeting, you should:
options: begin a virtual meeting by sharing the meeting agenda.
invite more people to participate because virtual meetings are typically not restricted in size due to the number of seats in a conference room.
make sure that participants have access to the technology and know how to use it effectively.
use technology you've used before so you don't have to worry about testing it prior to meeting with the group.
correct: make sure that participants have access to the technology and know how to use it effectively.

question: Eye contact with your team members can be maintained by:
options: always looking at a few people
always looking at your favourite people
always looking at the nearest people
looking at every individual in a regular pattern
correct: looking at every individual in a regular pattern

question: Four group level factors that combine to cause groupthink are
options: cohesion, isolation, biased leadership, decisional stress
cohesion, isolation, discouragement, biased leadership
cohesion, isolation, decisional stress, aggressiveness
isolation, biased leadership, aggressiveness, discouragement
correct: cohesion, isolation, biased leadership, decisional stress

question: John may try to bargain with Katy if...
options: Katy has more modest power over John, but John is still largely power dependent
John has more power than Katy.
Katy has more power than John.
Katy has significant power and John is highly dependent.
correct: Katy has more modest power over John, but John is still largely power dependent

question: Good advice for meeting participants may include:
options: become angry for no good reason.
demand much more information than is needed.
offer much more information than is needed.
demonstrate professionalism in your verbal and nonverbal interactions.
correct: demonstrate professionalism in your verbal and nonverbal interactions.

question: Meetings give members a/an ________ that boosts their motivation to implement group ideas and actions.
options: opportunity to participate in the group decision making process
chance to argue
time to relax
time to chat
correct: opportunity to participate in the group decision making process

question: Nonverbal behavior that reflects positive attitude is ____
options: moving your knees and your feet toward to door
looking at your watch
playing with your jewelry
leaning your body toward the person with whom you are conversing
correct: leaning your body toward the person with whom you are conversing

question: In a communication transaction, feedback represents
options: a group's physical and psychological environment.
anything that interferes with or inhibits effective communication.
the media through which group members share messages.
the response or reaction to a message.
correct: the response or reaction to a message.

question: In order to "Define the problem", which actions should we take?
options: Identify the problem, Identify facts, Provide examples, Organize the information logically
Identify the problem, Identify your most important goals
Identify the problem, Provide as many supporting details as possible, Provide examples, Organize the information logically
Identify the problem, Provide as many supporting details as possible, Identify your most important goals, Gather information and facts
correct: Identify the problem, Provide as many supporting details as possible, Provide examples, Organize the information logically

question: In which way does "Wikis" contribute to our ability to be critical and creative thinkers?
options: Wikis can help students coordinate, compile, synthesize, and present individual or group projects or research.
Wikis can help students build and share group resources and knowledge.
Wikis can help students provide peer review, feedback, and critiques.
All of these are correct
correct: All of these are correct

question: If you are applying for a job that is new or you have little or no experience, you should:
options: Let your personality shine through.
Read and learn as much as you can about the job before you apply.
Just accept that you probably won't get hired and do not apply at all.
Whatever happens will come, just let it be.
correct: Read and learn as much as you can about the job before you apply.

question: In a job interview, which of the following answers is most appropriate to answer the question "Are you planning a family in the near future?"
options: I suppose everyone has a family plan in their own way. What will be will be!
May I not answer this over personal question?
As an active person in the young generation, I am quite open to this issue, I am working hard to support my parents first, and then I gaining a high social status for my future children.
Currently I am focused on my career. Although having a family is always a possibility, it is not a priority at the moment.
correct: Currently I am focused on my career. Although having a family is always a possibility, it is not a priority at the moment.

question: In a job interview how should you best respond to interview questions?
options: Be enthusiastic, honest, sincere, and state your accomplishments in a specific and positive manner.
Embellish your achievements and accomplishments to make sure the employer remembers them.
Say that your achievements and accomplishments are detailed on your resume.
Use caution when describing what you have accomplished so you will not appear to be bragging on yourself.
correct: Be enthusiastic, honest, sincere, and state your accomplishments in a specific and positive manner.

question:
"I am the first person in my family to complete a Bachelor degree; and now that I have finished my education, I want to give something back to my family by getting a good job with a company like yours. I worked part time while attending school, so I have work experience at food stores. I am a hard worker; I grew up on the farm and could drive any kind of machinery."
This part of an application letter to software developer position is not effective because _______
options: It uses impersonal salutation.
It does not relate to the company needs.
It conveys negative tones.
It provides the family background of the applicant.
correct: It does not relate to the company needs.

question: Reward Power exists when:
options: person A has power over person B because A can administer some form of punishment to B.
person A gains power because A has knowledge or expertise relevant to B.
when person B submits to person A because B feels that A has a right to exert power in a certain domain.
when person A has power over person B because A controls rewards that B wants.
correct: when person A has power over person B because A controls rewards that B wants.

question: Regarding problem-solving action checklist, which of the following should be conducted "In the solutions" stage?
options: Compare and contrast possible solutions.
Provide as many supporting details as possible.
Organize the information logically.
Defend your solution.
correct: Compare and contrast possible solutions.

question: Social comparison can lead to
options: impacts on self-esteem, feeling of victory, feeling of humbleness.
impacts on self-esteem, feeling of envy, feeling of regret.
impacts on self-esteem, feeling of love, feeling of being superior.
Impacts on self-satisfaction, self-esteem, feeling of loser.
correct: impacts on self-esteem, feeling of envy, feeling of regret.

question: Power-over can be seen in which of the following situations?
options: A leader empowering a group through cooperation
A member dominating the conversation and controlling the group's resources
A group respecting each other's opinions and working collaboratively
A leader suggests ideas without imposing them on others
correct: A member dominating the conversation and controlling the group's resources
